  "title": "ubuntu documentation site not working NVDA Firefox",
  "body": "NVDA is a Windows screen reader used by blind individuals to read what's on screen. It appears your site has some sort of cookie banner that NVDA does not read in Firefox. I was able to access the site using Chrome, but it's really a hassle having to switch browsers, especially when this is not a terribly difficult problem to fix. Thanks.\r\n\r\n---\r\n*Reported from: https://ubuntu.com/server/docs/install/storage*",

    {
      "id": 849674548,
      "url": "https://github.com/canonical/ubuntu.com/issues/9785#issuecomment-849674548",
      "created_at": "2021-05-27T14:19:01Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 2",
      "body": "I believe this is related to this issue: https://github.com/nvaccess/nvda/issues/2745. I have replicated the behaviour in both Firefox which does not work and Chrome which does. I believe the markup should read the landmark as the region is focused but I am no expert. \r\n\r\nDoes anyone else have any other suggestions?"
    },
    {
      "id": 853426310,
      "url": "https://github.com/canonical/ubuntu.com/issues/9785#issuecomment-853426310",
      "created_at": "2021-06-02T22:34:10Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 1",
      "body": "@anthonydillon, this has something to do w/the way this alert is being coded, methinks. If it'd just be changed to a simple dialog w/an \"ok\" or \"got it\" button or equivalent, I think everything would be fine."
    },
    {
      "id": 985916711,
      "url": "https://github.com/canonical/ubuntu.com/issues/9785#issuecomment-985916711",
      "created_at": "2021-12-03T23:54:03Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 3",
      "body": "@abletec I believe this problem was fixed by another PR (https://github.com/canonical-web-and-design/cookie-policy/pull/123) in July - I've just tested the site with NVDA, and from what I can tell it seems to be OK, but please let us know if not."
    },
    {
      "id": 985923663,
      "url": "https://github.com/canonical/ubuntu.com/issues/9785#issuecomment-985923663",
      "created_at": "2021-12-04T00:14:46Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 1",
      "body": "Gentlemen, the cookie dialog now can be easily accessed by NVDA, so I\ncan now visit the site. Thanks so much for that.     },

    }
